blocks.text: Southeast Asian countries have formally adopted the Manila Declaration on Advancing the ASEAN Disaster Resilience Agenda toward 2030 and Beyond, committing the region to move disaster management beyond response and toward earlier action, stronger preparedness and measurable results.
